lead: A bench whose member costs milliseconds cannot declare `calls 0`.
body: Every declaration is met to within a hundredth per operation, and the one `Bench::run` frame is one divided by the iteration count — nothing at a few hundred thousand rounds, and well past the tolerance once the count has to stay tiny for the program to finish in under a second. Declare only `iterations` there; `benches/members/README.md` § *What a bench declares* is the rule.
